name: Admin Panel Projects Module
description: The Plataforma space in the panel sidebar opens /panel/projects: the commercial face of accounts.Project, the entity hostings, incomes and cuentas de cobro reference. The listing loads once and filters client-side by the active, user-managed lifecycle catalog. Its indicator header uses one fixed label/value/reserved-support structure and gives every visible card contextual help plus an explicit action. At expanded widths, non-zero lifecycle cards follow catalog order under Ciclo del proyecto; review, clients without projects and unlinked accounting records are grouped under Pendientes operativos. At 412px and 835px the header becomes exactly two actionable summaries whose drawers retain all lifecycle states, including zeroes, and every operational detail; the first project remains visible in the initial phone viewport. Activating a lifecycle indicator filters the list, while operational indicators open their corresponding workflow. Search remains accent/case-blind over project and client, sortable columns show name/client/state/created plus per-project hosting and income counts that — for superusers — link into the accounting tabs pre-filtered via ?project=<id>. The Clientes sin proyecto action opens the create path pre-seeded with that client. Create asks for name plus client and defaults to En desarrollo unless an initial catalog state is selected; later lifecycle changes are excluded from edit and belong to the previewed transition flow. A same-name project warns without blocking. At 412px and 835px state filtering is a selector, sorting stays explicit and the listing becomes one/two-column cards; from 1195px the table returns. Create, edit, orphan assignment, client change and lifecycle dialogs are full-screen on phones, with sticky actions; the page is capped at 1400px on wide monitors.
